status: fourth aggregation slice: a destination whose recomputed aggregate is unchanged is no longer re-scheduled; TodoMVC reaches K0-class diagnostics p50 with byte-identical diagnostics

change.cut: reschedule only destinations whose binding actually moved
change.what: invalidate_requirement_cone records each cleared binding instead of touching every affected destination, and the refresh commit compares the new aggregate against that recorded previous binding: equal aggregates restore the binding without running the schedule_variable dependent walk, changed aggregates touch exactly as before. The map is cleared at the start of every refresh and a debug assertion proves every recorded binding is refolded in the same refresh.
change.why: the phase probe showed TodoMVC refresh carrying about 27,000 touch calls at roughly 5-6 us each (invalidate 88.3 ms + commit 68.0 ms of a 311.5 ms refresh) while the requirement cone BFS visits only 12,690 edges: the cost was repeated consumer scans that found nothing new to enqueue.
change.soundness: the schedule walk is only needed when a consumer's input can move, and a consumer reads the destination's binding. An unchanged aggregate restores the identical binding; the invalidation BFS already marks every reachable requirement destination dirty, so the marking side effect of the removed touches is preserved. Refresh-before-read and the withdrawal invariant are untouched: the refresh still runs before every dequeue and still folds every dirty destination.

phase_probe_release.note: one release observation per fixture per build (diagnostics, fresh-process); the pairs are [baseline e618891c probe build, candidate probe build]

interleaved_ab.protocol: eight alternating rounds, one process per observation, release evidence lane, cold fresh-process
interleaved_ab.fingerprint_parity: the diagnostics lanes produced a single (diagnostics fingerprint, plan) pair across both binaries; the TodoMVC verified lane produced two pairs that differ only in the machine plan hash, never in the diagnostics fingerprint

todo_mvc_physical.shape: the candidate plan is the baseline plan with two projected-scalar expressions removed and downstream ids renumbered: the op-kind sequence aligns under a +2 id offset for 64,481 of 64,482 rows, and 501 rows differ beyond pure renumbering, concentrated around the rewrite and in binding tables
todo_mvc_physical.baseline_condition: the machine-plan-hash budget for TodoMVC and NovyWave verified is already red at HEAD e618891c (the budget constant is the K0-era plan), so this drift continues an inherited red rather than regressing a green gate

position: this is the first slice of the goal that moves end-to-end latency outside the noise floor: TodoMVC diagnostics p50 1088 -> 927 ms against the K0 producer's 922 ms, i.e. K0-class for that fixture and lane, with byte-identical diagnostics. NovyWave improves 7% and remains about 60% above K0, dominated by its recursive merge.
caveats: single machine, one boot; the A/B is interleaved one-process observations, not the full 3+30 A/B/A acceptance protocol
the TodoMVC machine plan changes shape as disclosed above; the plan-hash budget for the large fixtures is already red at baseline
the warm interaction path is the declared successor goal and is not measured here
NovyWave's remaining cost is the recursive merge (144.3 ms of a 247.8 ms refresh), not scheduling
